# To See It Once

*Tristram wants to see the thing in the deep water once, with his own eyes, not to kill it. Go with him at night to the rim of the Lantern Deep.*

|---|---|

## Objectives

1. Bring 20 [Glim Shard](../items/glim_shard.md) (taken)
2. Look at the rim of the Lantern Deep at night in [The Rim](../maps/the_rim.md)
3. Defeat 60 monsters in [The Rim](../maps/the_rim.md)
4. Defeat 40 [Glimshade](../monsters/glimshade.md) in [The Old Fellings](../maps/old_fellings.md)

## Rewards

- 98,971 EXP
- 2,010 mesos
- +60 standing with [Tristram](../npcs/tristram.md)
- +25 standing with Bain Harbour
